SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'

SELECT 'pending_booking' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'event',json_object('id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status!='delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('hold',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events

SELECT 'pending_bookings' AS check_name,count(*) AS violations FROM bookings WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'oversold',count(*) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity UNION ALL SELECT 'bad_confirmations',count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured')!=1 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM checkins x WHERE x.booking_id=b.booking_id AND x.flight_id=b.flight_id AND x.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)) UNION ALL SELECT 'bad_holds',count(*) FROM holds h LEFT JOIN bookings b ON h.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR h.flight_id!=b.flight_id OR h.passenger_id!=b.passenger_id OR b.status='cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'bad_checkins',count(*) FROM checkins x LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=x.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR b.status!='confirmed' OR x.flight_id!=b.flight_id OR x.passenger_id!=b.passenger_id UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_charges',count(*) FROM charges c LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel_event_unresolved',count(*) FROM customer_events e JOIN bookings b ON b.request_id=e.request_id WHERE b.status!='cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_without_event',count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_refunds',count(*) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND c.state='captured' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.charge_id=c.charge_id AND r.booking_id=b.booking_id AND r.amount_cents=c.amount_cents) UNION ALL SELECT 'unwarranted_refunds',count(*) FROM refunds r LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=r.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR b.status!='cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sales',count(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1) UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_events',count(*) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'
